test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct superlative degree of comparison for the given sentence.

I told him my __inner feelings__.

options.text: I told him my in feelings.
I told him my more inner feelings.
I told him my innermost feelings.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct superlative degree **of comparison for the given sentence is** 4)** I told him my innermost feelings.
 
• The** sentence states** that the speaker told someone their inner feelings, indicating a level of depth or intimacy.
 
• **To express** the **highest degree** of inner feelings, we use the superlative degree.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: *'I told him my **innermost **feelings.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1)** "I told him my feelings" is **incorrect **because it does not convey the superlative degree. It simply states that the speaker shared their feelings without specifying any degree of intensity.
 
• **Option 2)** "I told him my in feelings" is** incorrect **because "in feelings" is not a grammatically correct phrase and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3)** "I told him my more inner feelings" is **incorrect **because it uses the comparative degree ("more inner") instead of the superlative degree, and it also sounds awkward and unnatural.
